signature: surroundOnTarget(target: Object3D, opts?: { speed?: number; radius?: number; heightOffset?: number }): () => void

params.name: target
params.desc: 环绕的目标对象, 用 getWorldPosition 取世界坐标作为圆心

params.name: opts.speed
params.desc: 角速度 (弧度/秒), 默认 0.2 (约 31 秒一周)

params.name: opts.radius
params.desc: 距 target 的水平距离 (米), 不传用当前相机距离

params.name: opts.heightOffset
params.desc: 高度偏移 (米), 在 target.y 基础上加

code: const a6f = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('floorName', 'A_6F')[0]; if (!a6f) throw new Error('A_6F not found'); const stop = ssp.cameraController.surroundOnTarget(a6f, { speed: 0.3 }); setTimeout(stop, 1000); console.log('surrounding A_6F for 1 second');
example: const obj = ssp.objectsTool.getById('A_6F_mesh_0'); const stop = ssp.cameraController.surroundOnTarget(obj, { speed: 0.5, radius: 80, heightOffset: 10 }); setTimeout(stop, 10000);
guard: 调用返回的 stop 函数停止环绕 (推荐)
新环绕会自动停掉旧环绕 (单例)
